brief: Five records from the US round (14 November 2026) carried only commentary as evidence (source rank 4), which cannot set a record's status, so the Fabric made each a lead instead of a record. Each is proposed again here with the official text or the regulator's own publication as evidence, the record otherwise as first proposed. New York's and Colorado's take their state codes (decided 15 November 2026). The leads from the first submission (TRG-LEAD-…) stay as they are; they can be closed once these records are approved.
